tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Stratum E will open with a Phase 1 Run-In to determine the RP2D of ribociclib PfOS formulation in combination with temozolomide in patients newly-diagnosed with DHG, H3G34-mutant post-RT, with PK testing.

role_evidence.quote: Ribociclib (other names: Kisqali): Ribociclib PO qd on days 1-21

agents.drug_class_hint: CDK4/6 inhibitor (approved for breast cancer); powder for oral suspension formulation
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: targets cell cycle pathway alterations (CDK4/6, CDKN2A/B/C, CCND1/2)

role_evidence.quote: post-radiotherapy (RT) combination of ribociclib and everolimus to treat pediatric, adolescent, and young adult patients newly diagnosed with HGG and DIPG that harbor alterations of the cell cycle and/or PI3K/mTOR pathways

agents.drug_class_hint: mTOR inhibitor (approved oncology and transplant indications)

role_evidence.quote: As most DHG, H3G34-mutant tumors are MGMT promoter methylated and receive temozolomide as part of standard of care, we are studying the adjuvant combination of ribociclib and temozolomide following upfront RT.

source_quote.quote: Deletion of CDKN2A, CDKN2B, or CDKN2C
Pathogenic alterations presumed to cause activation of the PI3K/mTOR pathway:
Deletion or mutation of TSC1 or TSC2
Patients with evidence of homozygous (biallelic) RB1 loss by sequencing are excluded from TarGeT-A

coder_notes: Paediatric and young adult trial (age 12 months to 39 years; stdAges CHILD, ADULT -> mixed_age). Glioblastoma named in conditions and Stratum B label; mixed HGG population. Ribociclib role differs: experimental_combination with everolimus in Strata A-D, but the only investigational agent (experimental_monotherapy) on a temozolomide backbone in Stratum E. Ribociclib formulation_flag new_formulation for the powder for oral suspension (PfOS). Cell-cycle and PI3K/mTOR alterations are required ('at least one') for Strata A-D, coded enrichment; RB1 biallelic loss is an exclusion criterion linked to CDK4/6 inhibition. CCND1/2 amplification is part of the same cell-cycle requirement (covered by CDK4_6_pathway row). H3K27M is mentioned only as an example histology in Stratum B, not a requirement; not listed. PK testing in Stratum E without sample type -> tumour PK unclear; 'longitudinal biomarker correlatives' unspecified -> target engagement unclear. Primary outcomes compare with molecularly matched historical controls (no control arm).
